gaps.sentence: This old house needs doing ___ before winter.
gaps.explanation: do up = repair and decorate a building. (British usage)

gaps.sentence: Please fill ___ this form and sign at the bottom.
gaps.explanation: fill in/out a form (British prefers in).

gaps.sentence: It took the committee weeks to wade ___ the paperwork.
gaps.hint: wade ___ = plod through a lot of
gaps.explanation: 'Wade through' = work slowly through a large amount of tedious material.

gaps.sentence: The band broke ___ in the middle of the song.

gaps.explanation: pick up = learn without formal study; also collect (pick somebody up).

gaps.sentence: When the alarm sounded, everyone made ___ the nearest exit.
gaps.explanation: 'Make for' = move towards, usually in haste.

gaps.sentence: The concert tickets sold ___ within an hour.
gaps.explanation: sell out = all tickets/goods are sold.

gaps.sentence: She put her ideas ___ clearly and confidently.
gaps.explanation: put across = communicate an idea successfully.
